title: AI & Generative AI
summary: Learn how modern AI works and build real applications with large language models. Go from Python and machine-learning basics to prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation and AI agents, and finish with projects you can show employers.

syllabus.title: Python for AI
topics: Python basics, data structures and functions

syllabus.title: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
topics: Question answering over your own documents

syllabus.title: Shipping AI applications responsibly
topics: A simple web interface and API for your app

projects: A document Q&A assistant that answers questions from PDFs using retrieval-augmented generation
A customer-support chatbot that gives structured answers and hands off to a human
An AI agent that researches a topic with tools and writes a summary report
A machine-learning text classifier for sentiment or support tickets
mentorship: Every student gets a personal mentor from the industry for the whole programme. Your mentor reviews your projects, helps when you are stuck, and guides you one to one on your portfolio, GitHub and LinkedIn profile, resume and interview preparation.
internship: Students who complete the projects and the final evaluation are considered for internship opportunities through E2Job, and everyone gets practical industry exposure through real-world projects and expert sessions. Internships depend on your performance and on availability; they are not guaranteed.
certificate: Complete the live sessions, at least two hands-on industry projects and the final evaluation to receive an E2Job Certificate of Completion. It shows the programme, your level and the duration, and carries a unique certificate ID.

faq.question: Who is this programme for?
faq.answer: B.Tech, BCA, MCA, MBA and other students and recent graduates who want to build AI-powered applications.

faq.question: Do I need prior experience?
faq.answer: Basic programming helps but is not required for Foundation, which starts with Python from the beginning. Professional and Advanced expect you to be comfortable with Python.

faq.question: Which level should I choose?
faq.answer: There are three levels. Foundation is for beginners, Professional is for students who know the basics and want job-ready depth, and Advanced is for those ready for complex, industry-level work. Pick the closest one in the enquiry form; our team will confirm the right level with you on the call.

faq.question: How are classes taught?
faq.answer: Through live, interactive sessions led by industry experts, with hands-on practice, assignments and doubt-clearing. You also get a personal mentor for project reviews and guidance.

faq.question: What are the fees, and when do classes start?
faq.answer: Fees, the trainer and batch timings are shared by our team after you enquire. Fill in the enquiry form and we will contact you.

faq.question: Do you guarantee a job or an internship?
faq.answer: No. We do not guarantee placements or internships. You get career support: access to the E2Job job and internship portal, interview preparation, help with your resume and portfolio, and internship opportunities based on your performance.

faq.question: What do I get when I finish?
faq.answer: An E2Job Certificate of Completion, at least two projects for your portfolio, and an updated resume, GitHub and LinkedIn profile.
